topic: forgiving someone who never said sorry
lines: A traveler asked why anger lingered after a harsh remark.
The teacher lifted a red-hot rock.
He dropped it into a bowl of cold water.
Steam rose, then the rock grew cold.
“You keep the rock,” he said, “until it cools.”
Let the heat disappear before you grab it again.
Choose the burn or walk away, you.
Follow for more daily life changing wisdom.
cta: Follow for more daily life changing wisdom.
caption: When anger burns, give it time to cool. Save this if it helps.
